targets.doc/signature_limit.md:
# Signature limit

A single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only, as per the CFO directive of 1 July 2026. [[cite:obs-55f345dd82dc0a69957793d2602caee070e3f0c1 "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]]

Where the CFO directive of 1 July 2026 and the procurement policy differ, the directive applies. [[cite:obs-55f345dd82dc0a69957793d2602caee070e3f0c1 "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]]

The procurement policy states that a single signature suffices for purchases up to two thousand (2000) EUR. [[cite:obs-191020828576f0c9c71183233dac4a718173013b "A single signature suffices for purchases up to two thousand (2000) EUR."]]
